scope: Go-and-return rigid and eight fixed-end wires on the current support and tabletop base, at 1 degree with 0.1 degree first-contact refinement. Prescribed GH poses with SC, AC, elbow and slider held neutral. Signed leverage is the exact derivative of the prescribed blended wire path. Gap is taken for the active wire, capped at 3 mm. Floating cuff poses, TPU deformation and muscular dynamics are excluded.
